# @aponiajs/config

> Nest-style configuration module for AponiaJS (`ConfigModule`, `ConfigService`, `registerAs`), with `.env` loading, `${VAR}` expansion, namespaced factories, and schema validation.

## Key exports

- `ConfigModule.forRoot(options)`
- `ConfigModule.forRootAsync(options)`
- `ConfigModule.forFeature(factory)`
- `ConfigService` (`get`, `getOrThrow`, `internalConfig`)
- `registerAs(token, factory)`
- `getConfigToken(token)`
